Text:
Nose breathing vs. mouth breathing — the difference goes deeper than you think. 🔍

✅ Nose breathing filters air, supports proper tongue posture, and keeps the jaw in a natural resting position.
❌ Mouth breathing can lead to forward head posture, jaw misalignment, and chronic TMJ tension over time.

Experiencing jaw pain, headaches, or facial tension? Your breathing pattern could be a contributing factor. We like to look at the full picture, not just your teeth.
